commands.name: workspace overview
commands.summary: The current workspace and the member reading it.

commands.name: workspace rename
commands.summary: Change a workspace's display name.

commands.name: workspace setState
commands.summary: Set the workspace to active, read-only or frozen (TECHNICAL-PLAN §4.1, the freeze overlay).

commands.name: workspace provision
commands.summary: Create a workspace and its first member for a newly registered person.

commands.name: people updateOwnProfile
commands.summary: Update the signed-in member's own timezone, avatar, bio, primary channel or quiet hours.

commands.name: people updateMember
commands.summary: Update another member's name, title or manager (org fields).

commands.name: people suspend
commands.summary: Suspend a member, removing every access they had.

commands.name: people restore
commands.summary: Restore a suspended member's access.

commands.name: people convertToGuest
commands.summary: Convert a member to a guest, stripping their prior bindings.

commands.name: people erase
commands.summary: Anonymise a member: their history stays attributable to a placeholder identity, and their personal data is exported first.

commands.name: people directory
commands.summary: Every active member of the workspace.

commands.name: people orgChart
commands.summary: The manager chain as a tree.

commands.name: people possibleManagers
commands.summary: Every member who could safely become this member's manager.

commands.name: invitations createWorkspaceLink
commands.summary: Create a reusable link anyone holding it may join through.

commands.name: invitations createPersonalLink
commands.summary: Invite one email address, usable once.

commands.name: invitations revokeLink
commands.summary: Revoke a link. Already-used memberships are unaffected.

commands.name: invitations acceptLink
commands.summary: Accept an invite link and join the workspace.

commands.name: invitations joinByTrustedDomain
commands.summary: Join a workspace automatically because your email domain is trusted.

commands.name: channels listConnections
commands.summary: Every channel provider this workspace has connected.

commands.name: channels connect
commands.summary: Stores a provider's credentials and marks it connected.

commands.name: channels disconnect
commands.summary: Removes a provider's connection and its stored credentials.

commands.name: channels listIdentities
commands.summary: The caller's own linked channel identities.

commands.name: channels linkIdentity
commands.summary: Links the caller's own account on a provider.

commands.name: channels startLink
commands.summary: Issues a short code for linking the caller's own account.

commands.name: channels unlinkIdentity
commands.summary: Unlinks the caller's own account on a provider.

commands.name: channels send
commands.summary: Queues one message to a member, at most once per key.

commands.name: channels listMessages
commands.summary: The recent outbound message log, newest first.

commands.name: channels mySettings
commands.summary: The caller's own primary channel, quiet hours and linked accounts.

commands.name: channels testSend
commands.summary: Queues a test message to the caller through the normal path.

commands.name: channels templates
commands.summary: The WhatsApp templates this workspace has at Meta.

commands.name: channels syncTemplates
commands.summary: Records the WhatsApp templates a sync read from Meta.

commands.name: channels templateMappings
commands.summary: Which WhatsApp template each reminder rule uses.

commands.name: channels saveTemplateMapping
commands.summary: Points one reminder rule at one approved WhatsApp template.

commands.name: channels removeTemplateMapping
commands.summary: Forgets which WhatsApp template a reminder rule used.

commands.name: connections mine
commands.summary: The external agents this member connected, newest first.

commands.name: connections revoke
commands.summary: End one of your own connections to an external agent.

commands.name: tokens mine
commands.summary: The signed-in member's own API tokens, newest first.

commands.name: tokens create
commands.summary: Mint an API token, shown once, carrying your own authority.

commands.name: tokens revoke
commands.summary: Revoke one of your own API tokens.

commands.name: tokens pendingDevice
commands.summary: The terminal request one device code names, if it is still open.

commands.name: tokens approveDevice
commands.summary: Approve or deny a terminal that asked to sign in as you.

commands.name: copilot ask
commands.summary: Records a question for the copilot, starting a conversation if this is the first one.

commands.name: copilot recordAnswer
commands.summary: Records the copilot's answer to the last question in a conversation.

commands.name: copilot thread
commands.summary: One copilot conversation, with the citations this reader may see.

commands.name: copilot threads
commands.summary: The reader's own copilot conversations, most recent first.

commands.name: copilot availability
commands.summary: Whether the copilot can answer, and why not when it cannot.

commands.name: copilot recordProposal
commands.summary: Records a proposal the copilot made in a conversation.

commands.name: copilot proposals
commands.summary: The proposals the copilot made in one conversation.

commands.name: copilot applyProposal
commands.summary: Applies one copilot proposal through the normal Operation pipeline.

commands.name: copilot dismissProposal
commands.summary: Dismisses one copilot proposal without applying it.

commands.name: copilot undoProposal
commands.summary: Reverses an applied copilot proposal, where the action has a reverse.

commands.name: blobs prepareUpload
commands.summary: Reserve a storage key for an upload, after validating it.

commands.name: blobs claimUpload
commands.summary: Finalise an upload once the bytes are in storage.

commands.name: blobs getForDownload
commands.summary: Resolve a blob's storage key, after checking access to it.

commands.name: notifications list
commands.summary: The signed-in member's own inbox.

commands.name: notifications markRead
commands.summary: Marks one of the signed-in member's own notifications read.

commands.name: notifications snooze
commands.summary: Hides one of the signed-in member's own notifications until later.

commands.name: notifications getSettings
commands.summary: The signed-in member's own notification settings.

commands.name: notifications updateSettings
commands.summary: Updates the signed-in member's own notification settings.

commands.name: subscriptions toggle
commands.summary: Subscribes or unsubscribes the signed-in member from a subject.

commands.name: activities workspaceFeed
commands.summary: The workspace-scoped activity feed, newest first.

commands.name: settings readWorkspaceSettings
commands.summary: The workspace's own settings map, for the admin cards.

commands.name: settings updateWorkspaceGeneral
commands.summary: Change the workspace's timezone, language or trusted email domains.

commands.name: settings updateWorkspaceBranding
commands.summary: Replace the workspace's branding.

commands.name: settings resetWorkspaceSettings
commands.summary: Reset one workspace setting, or a whole admin card, to its default.

commands.name: ai readProviderConfig
commands.summary: Every provider's admin configuration, with a masked hint for its workspace key.

commands.name: ai updateProviderConfig
commands.summary: Turns a provider on or off for this workspace, and whether members may add a personal key for it.

commands.name: ai setWorkspaceCredential
commands.summary: Sets or replaces the workspace's own key for a provider.

commands.name: ai removeWorkspaceCredential
commands.summary: Removes the workspace's own key for a provider.

commands.name: ai setPersonalCredential
commands.summary: Sets or replaces the signed-in member's own key for a provider.

commands.name: ai removePersonalCredential
commands.summary: Removes the signed-in member's own key for a provider.

commands.name: ai readOwnCredentialStatus
commands.summary: Which providers accept a personal key, and whether the signed-in member has one.

commands.name: ai rotateCredentials
commands.summary: Re-wraps every credential this workspace stores onto the current root key.

commands.name: ai readModelCatalog
commands.summary: The seeded model catalogue plus this workspace's own custom entries.

commands.name: ai addCustomModel
commands.summary: Adds a custom or self-hosted model, with its own context window and cost figures.

commands.name: ai updateCustomModel
commands.summary: Edits a custom model's context window, cost figures or tier tags.

commands.name: ai removeCustomModel
commands.summary: Removes a custom model from the catalogue.

commands.name: ai readTierRouting
commands.summary: Every tier's effective route: an explicit policy, or the seeded default for whatever this workspace has enabled.

commands.name: ai setTierPolicy
commands.summary: Maps a tier to a specific provider, model and sampling settings for this workspace.

commands.name: ai removeTierPolicy
commands.summary: Removes a tier's explicit policy, reverting it to the seeded default.

commands.name: ai readFeatureSettings
commands.summary: Every feature's admin-configured switch and tier override.

commands.name: ai updateFeatureSetting
commands.summary: Turns one AI feature on or off, and optionally pins it to a different tier.

commands.name: ai readPrompt
commands.summary: The current system prompt for a feature or agent phase, and every prior version.

commands.name: ai updatePrompt
commands.summary: Records a new version of a feature or agent phase's system prompt.

commands.name: ai restorePrompt
commands.summary: Removes every stored version for a prompt key, so the built-in default serves again.

commands.name: ai readBudgets
commands.summary: Every configured budget for this workspace, per user, per agent and workspace-wide.

commands.name: ai setBudget
commands.summary: Sets or replaces a budget: per user, per agent or workspace-wide.

commands.name: ai removeBudget
commands.summary: Removes a budget.

commands.name: ai readUsageSummary
commands.summary: Total calls, tokens, cost and flagged calls for this workspace since a given date.

commands.name: agents list
commands.summary: Every agent this workspace has, seeded or custom.

commands.name: agents create
commands.summary: Creates an agent: its own member record, kind = 'agent', with no access until bound.

commands.name: agents setEnabled
commands.summary: Turns an agent on or off.

commands.name: agents bindScope
commands.summary: Grants an agent's member group a binding on one named resource — never workspace-wide.

commands.name: agents startRun
commands.summary: Starts a run for an agent against an already-decomposed task list.

commands.name: agents readRun
commands.summary: One run's status, task progress, cost and its full append-only log.

commands.name: agents cancelRun
commands.summary: Cancels a run that is still planning or running.

commands.name: agents runChampion
commands.summary: Runs the Champion's nudge queue once, recording what fired in its run log.

commands.name: agents runCoach
commands.summary: Runs the Coach's quality pass once, recording what fired in its run log.

commands.name: agents listRuns
commands.summary: Recent agent runs with their logs, newest first.

commands.name: proposals list
commands.summary: Every pending proposal waiting in the review inbox.

commands.name: proposals bulkApply
commands.summary: Applies one or more pending proposals through the normal Operation pipeline, with the deciding member as the actor.

commands.name: proposals bulkDismiss
commands.summary: Dismisses one or more pending proposals without applying them.

commands.name: spaces list
commands.summary: Every space this member can see, with their own role in each.

commands.name: spaces read
commands.summary: One space with its members and who runs its weekly session.

commands.name: spaces create
commands.summary: Creates a space, with an optional first manager.

commands.name: spaces update
commands.summary: Renames a space or rewrites its mission.

commands.name: spaces archive
commands.summary: Archives a space. Its goals and history stay readable.

commands.name: spaces addMember
commands.summary: Adds a member to a space in a role, granting that role's access.

commands.name: spaces setMemberRole
commands.summary: Changes a space member's role, replacing what that role grants.

commands.name: spaces removeMember
commands.summary: Removes a member from a space and takes back its access.

commands.name: spaces join
commands.summary: Joins a space as an ordinary member.

commands.name: spaces leave
commands.summary: Leaves a space. The space stays visible and rejoinable.

commands.name: cycles list
commands.summary: Every cycle this workspace has, newest first.

commands.name: cycles current
commands.summary: The cycle to show: the one containing today, else the soonest ahead, else the most recent behind.

commands.name: cycles ensureCurrent
commands.summary: Creates the cycle containing today if the workspace has none. Idempotent.

commands.name: cycles create
commands.summary: Creates a named cycle for the period containing a chosen date.

commands.name: cycles update
commands.summary: Sets a cycle's roles, phase, levels, session dates or publication deadline.

commands.name: cycles archive
commands.summary: Archives a cycle. Its goals and scores stay readable.

commands.name: cycles snapshot
commands.summary: Records what a cycle achieved: the result, the band counts and the portfolio verdict, one snapshot per owner.

commands.name: cycles feedForward
commands.summary: Hands METHOD.md §8.9's inheritance to the next cycle: prior scores, carried work as issues at impact four, and the annual frame.

commands.name: cycles scorecard
commands.summary: Every archived cycle's result with its band counts and verdict, oldest first. Drives the scorecard.

commands.name: rhythm read
commands.summary: The METHOD.md §11 registry as this workspace resolves it, with its deviations and its terminology.

commands.name: rhythm update
commands.summary: Changes this workspace's deviations from the §11 canon, or its terminology.

commands.name: frame read
commands.summary: The current annual frame and its strategic thrusts.

commands.name: frame set
commands.summary: Creates or replaces the current annual frame. A replacement supersedes rather than edits.

commands.name: workflow read
commands.summary: A cycle's phase completion, its six publish gates and the rows they are computed from.

commands.name: workflow setPackItem
commands.summary: Marks one of the seven §2.6 input-pack items gathered, with a note.

commands.name: workflow distributePack
commands.summary: Records that the input pack reached people, which the §2.6 lead time is measured from.

commands.name: workflow addIssue
commands.summary: Adds a ranked strategic issue to a cycle's phase 2 list.

commands.name: workflow setIssueImpact
commands.summary: Reranks a strategic issue. The list is ordered by impact.

commands.name: workflow addPriority
commands.summary: Adds a phase 3 priority, optionally promoting the issue it came from.

commands.name: workflow setRevalidation
commands.summary: Records the quarterly revalidation: the frame holds, or changed with a note.

commands.name: workflow setBaselineHealth
commands.summary: Records phase 2's KPI reading in the three §8.5 columns: stable, declining, business as usual.

commands.name: workflow setCapacityNotes
commands.summary: Records what was cut, which publish gate 5 reads (§5.5: if nothing was cut, capacity was not checked).

commands.name: workflow calibrate
commands.summary: Records the one mid-cycle calibration a cycle is allowed (METHOD.md §7.6).

commands.name: workflow publish
commands.summary: Publishes the set, refusing while any of the six gates is red or cannot be evaluated.

commands.name: initiatives list
commands.summary: Initiatives in a space, or the ones serving one key result. Drives screen S-26.

commands.name: initiatives read
commands.summary: One initiative with the key results it serves.

commands.name: initiatives create
commands.summary: Creates an initiative in a space, owned by one member.

commands.name: initiatives update
commands.summary: Updates an initiative's own fields. Progress is derived from its tasks and is not one of them.

commands.name: initiatives delete
commands.summary: Soft-deletes an initiative and the links it held.

commands.name: initiatives linkKeyResult
commands.summary: Records that this initiative is one of the ones that will move a key result (METHOD.md §5.5).

commands.name: initiatives unlinkKeyResult
commands.summary: Removes the link between an initiative and a key result.

commands.name: initiatives capacity
commands.summary: One cycle's capacity check: every key result's verdict and every initiative behind it (METHOD.md §5.5).

commands.name: goals list
commands.summary: Goals in a cycle, or the whole workspace, with their key results attached.

commands.name: goals read
commands.summary: One goal with its key results and its retrospective, if it has one.

commands.name: goals create
commands.summary: Creates a goal with its champion, its reviewer and its access context.

commands.name: goals update
commands.summary: Edits a goal's own fields, including its alignment pointer.

commands.name: goals close
commands.summary: Closes a goal with an outcome, a keep/modify/abandon decision and a retrospective.

commands.name: goals delete
commands.summary: Removes a goal and its key results, which is not the same as closing one.

commands.name: goals reviewDecision
commands.summary: The keep/modify/abandon decision the last quarterly review reached for this goal.

commands.name: goals reopen
commands.summary: Reopens a closed goal, clearing its outcome and keeping its retrospective.

commands.name: goals reassignRole
commands.summary: Moves the champion or the reviewer to another member, rebinding access with it.

commands.name: goals moveToCycle
commands.summary: Moves a goal into another cycle, taking its check-in history with it.

commands.name: goals addKeyResult
commands.summary: Adds a key result to a goal, with its baseline recorded as history.

commands.name: goals updateKeyResult
commands.summary: Edits a key result's definition. The current value has its own action, because it is history.

commands.name: goals recordValue
commands.summary: Moves a key result's value and records the movement as history.

commands.name: goals unlinkKpi
commands.summary: Unlinks a KPI, keeping the value it last reported as a manual one.

commands.name: goals keyResultHistory
commands.summary: One key result's value history, newest first. Drives the sparkline.

commands.name: goals due
commands.summary: The goals this member champions that are due a check-in, soonest first. Drives the session walker.

commands.name: goals checkIns
commands.summary: One goal's check-in timeline, newest first, with each one's snapshot differences.

commands.name: goals rewriteKeyResult
commands.summary: Suggests a corrected key result for one failing check, and reports which checks the suggestion actually passes.

commands.name: goals draftObjective
commands.summary: Drafts an objective and its key results from a plain-language ambition, with the quality checks it passes.

commands.name: goals suggestMeasure
commands.summary: Suggests a unit, a direction, a baseline and a target for a key result, with the checks they pass.

commands.name: goals suggestParent
commands.summary: Suggests which objective this one should align to, from the ones the reader may see.

commands.name: goals parseFilter
commands.summary: Turns a sentence into a validated goals filter, or refuses it with the reason.

commands.name: goals startCheckIn
commands.summary: Opens or reopens the author's draft check-in on a goal. Completely silent.

commands.name: goals publishCheckIn
commands.summary: Publishes a check-in: snapshot, value history, cadence, and the reviewer's obligation.

commands.name: goals publishDraftedCheckIn
commands.summary: Opens the author's draft check-in on a goal and publishes it in one action, for a proposal a human applies.

commands.name: goals editCheckIn
commands.summary: Edits a published check-in inside its window, writing a new snapshot rather than rewriting the old one.

commands.name: goals deleteCheckIn
commands.summary: Deletes a check-in, rolling the goal's pointers and values back when it was the latest.

commands.name: goals acknowledgeCheckIn
commands.summary: The reviewer of record closes the loop. Nobody else can.

commands.name: goals vote
commands.summary: A private confidence vote on one key result. Readable only by its author until the reveal.

commands.name: goals revealVotes
commands.summary: Reveals every vote on a key result in one write, so no client sees a partial reveal.

commands.name: goals readVotes
commands.summary: The votes on one key result: only your own until the reveal, all of them and the average after it.

commands.name: goals addDependency
commands.summary: Links two goals as depending on each other. Stored once; direction carries no meaning.

commands.name: goals removeDependency
commands.summary: Removes a horizontal link between two goals.

commands.name: goals addKeyResultDependency
commands.summary: Records a key result's dependency on a providing team, for the register (METHOD.md §5.4).

commands.name: goals confirmDependency
commands.summary: The providing team confirms a dependency. Only they can, and it clears publish gate 4.

commands.name: goals setDependencyRiskOwner
commands.summary: Names who carries the risk of an unconfirmed dependency. Clears publish gate 4 without claiming a confirmation.

commands.name: goals removeKeyResultDependency
commands.summary: Removes an entry from the dependency register.

commands.name: alignment read
commands.summary: The alignment health score for one cycle, with every open finding and the goal each one opens.

commands.name: alignment graph
commands.summary: The cascade as nodes and edges, for the alignment studio canvas (S-16).

commands.name: goals relations
commands.summary: The parent, children, horizontal dependencies and register entries of one goal.

commands.name: kpis createCategory
commands.summary: Adds a KPI category, which is how the grid groups its rows.

commands.name: kpis create
commands.summary: Adds a KPI with its frequency, unit, direction, tier and corridor thresholds.

commands.name: kpis record
commands.summary: Records a value for the period a date falls in. Re-recording updates rather than duplicating.

commands.name: kpis grid
commands.summary: Every KPI with its recent periods, grouped by category. Drives screen S-20.

commands.name: kpis setFormula
commands.summary: Makes a KPI calculated from a formula over other KPIs, refusing self-reference and cycles.

commands.name: kpis createTree
commands.summary: Names a driver tree. The parent pointers shape it; this row is the tree itself.

commands.name: kpis launchRecovery
commands.summary: Creates METHOD.md §6.5's recovery objective from the leading drivers under an unhealthy KPI.

commands.name: kpis recoveryDraft
commands.summary: The recovery objective a KPI would get, so it can be read before it is committed to.

commands.name: kpis recoveryBoard
commands.summary: Every unhealthy or recovering KPI across every tree, with its recovery objective. Drives screen S-19.

commands.name: kpis tree
commands.summary: One driver tree as nodes with their corridor state and recovery progress. Drives screen S-18.

commands.name: kpis detail
commands.summary: One KPI with its periods, its place in the tree and its formula. Drives screen S-21.

commands.name: kpis update
commands.summary: Edits a KPI's own fields, where it hangs in the tree, and which tree it belongs to.

commands.name: alignment dismissFinding
commands.summary: Dismisses a finding. It stays dismissed while the condition is unchanged.

commands.name: alignment applyFinding
commands.summary: Applies a relink finding by re-parenting the goal through the normal update path.

commands.name: review inbox
commands.summary: What this member owes right now, overdue first. Drives screen S-02 and the sidebar badge.

commands.name: comments list
commands.summary: List comments on a subject

commands.name: comments create
commands.summary: Post a comment on a goal, key result, check-in, cycle or document

commands.name: comments update
commands.summary: Edit a comment (author only)

commands.name: comments delete
commands.summary: Delete a comment (author or moderator with edit access)

commands.name: comments previewNotify
commands.summary: Preview who would be notified by a comment with this body on this subject

commands.name: nudges run
commands.summary: Computes what is due for every member, records a nudge row for each, and delivers what is due to the inbox and the member's own channel.

commands.name: nudges list
commands.summary: This member's nudges, newest first, with the rule that caused each one.

commands.name: nudges snooze
commands.summary: Silences nudges about one subject for this member until a time they choose. Never silences the obligation itself.

commands.name: nudges volume
commands.summary: How many nudges each rule produced over a window, and how many were suppressed and why.

commands.name: reactions list
commands.summary: List reactions on a subject, grouped by emoji

commands.name: reactions add
commands.summary: Add a reaction to any subject

commands.name: reactions remove
commands.summary: Remove your own reaction

commands.name: sessions create
commands.summary: Creates a scheduled session for a space.

commands.name: sessions open
commands.summary: Opens a scheduled session, setting it to running and starting the first stage.

commands.name: sessions advanceStage
commands.summary: Advances a running session to its next stage, recording elapsed time.

commands.name: sessions skip
commands.summary: Marks a scheduled session as skipped.

commands.name: sessions close
commands.summary: Closes a running session.

commands.name: sessions read
commands.summary: One session by id. Returns not-found when the caller lacks access.

commands.name: sessions list
commands.summary: Sessions for a space, newest first.

commands.name: sessions mine
commands.summary: Sessions in every space this member can read, running first.

commands.name: sessions participants
commands.summary: Active space members for a session's space.

commands.name: sessions castVote
commands.summary: A private confidence vote on one key result within a session. Upserts: a second vote replaces the first.

commands.name: sessions revealVotes
commands.summary: Reveals every vote on a key result in one session, atomically.

commands.name: sessions confirmConfidence
commands.summary: The champion confirms the final confidence and writes the what-changed note.

commands.name: sessions votes
commands.summary: Votes for one KR in a session. Before reveal: own vote only. After reveal: all.

commands.name: sessions confidenceStatus
commands.summary: Which KRs are confirmed vs unconfirmed in this session.

commands.name: sessions createBlocker
commands.summary: Opens a blocker for a low-confidence KR during the diagnose step. The 24-hour clock starts on save.

commands.name: sessions resolveBlocker
commands.summary: Marks a blocker as resolved.

commands.name: sessions reassignBlocker
commands.summary: Moves a blocker to a different owner.

commands.name: sessions blockerStatus
commands.summary: Blockers for a session, with aging information.

commands.name: blockers board
commands.summary: Every open blocker in a space, ranked by escalation, then by what it blocks, then by age.

commands.name: blockers summarise
commands.summary: Summarises a space's open blockers, over the product's own ranking, refusing a summary that names one not on the board.

commands.name: sessions setCommitments
commands.summary: Sets this week's commitments (2-3 actions, each with owner and optional KR link).

commands.name: sessions closeCommitments
commands.summary: Closes last week's commitments with a delivered/not-delivered verdict.

commands.name: sessions listCommitments
commands.summary: Commitments for a session.

commands.name: sessions setCoordinatorNote
commands.summary: Adds the coordinator's note to the session digest.

commands.name: sessions readStreak
commands.summary: The rhythm streak for a space.

commands.name: sessions digest
commands.summary: The weekly digest for one session, assembled from METHOD.md §7.2 step 4 with no provider involved.

commands.name: sessions narrateDigest
commands.summary: Rewrites the weekly digest as prose, refusing any narration that states a number the product did not compute.

commands.name: kpis narrateTrend
commands.summary: Narrates a KPI's trend and its anomalies, refusing any narration that states a number the series does not hold.

commands.name: kpis suggest
commands.summary: Suggests a metric, its corridor and its formula from a sentence, with §6's parser checking the formula first.

commands.name: sessions addMinute
commands.summary: Gives the running stage one more minute (METHOD.md §8.1's add-a-minute control).

commands.name: sessions givePulse
commands.summary: Records one participant's pulse and their one word for the cycle (METHOD.md §8.2).

commands.name: sessions scoreKeyResult
commands.summary: Grades one key result 0.0 to 1.0 with the one-line reason §8.3 asks for.

commands.name: sessions revealObjectiveScore
commands.summary: Reveals one objective's score to the whole room in a single write (METHOD.md §8.3).

commands.name: sessions passMic
commands.summary: Hands the mic to one objective's owner, or puts it down (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 3).

commands.name: sessions setNarrative
commands.summary: Writes what the number does not show for one objective (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 3).

commands.name: sessions narratives
commands.summary: Stage three's state: who holds the mic, who has spoken, and what was written.

commands.name: sessions giveKudos
commands.summary: Names the effort that deserved to be seen (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 4).

commands.name: sessions recognition
commands.summary: Stage four's entries, oldest first (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 4).

commands.name: sessions addRetroNote
commands.summary: Writes one note into the team retro's worked or did-not column (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 5).

commands.name: sessions removeRetroNote
commands.summary: Removes one retro note, with the dots spent on it.

commands.name: sessions castRetroVote
commands.summary: Spends or withdraws one dot on a retro note (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 5).

commands.name: sessions retro
commands.summary: The team retro board: both columns, their notes and the reader's dots.

commands.name: sessions setManagementAnswer
commands.summary: Records leadership's answer to one of §8.7's four questions (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 6).

commands.name: sessions managementRetro
commands.summary: §8.7's four questions with what leadership answered (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 6).

commands.name: sessions setRootCause
commands.summary: Names the one primary cause for a key result that came in under the threshold (METHOD.md §8.4).

commands.name: sessions rootCauses
commands.summary: Every key result this review graded below the threshold, with its cause (METHOD.md §8.4).

commands.name: sessions submitProcessHealth
commands.summary: Scores §8.5's five statements anonymously (METHOD.md §8.1 stage 8).

commands.name: sessions processHealth
commands.summary: §8.5's five statements with the room's averages, and the reader's own answers.

commands.name: sessions recordDiagnostic
commands.summary: Reads §8.6's diagnostic and stores what the room was told (METHOD.md §8.6).

commands.name: sessions diagnostic
commands.summary: §8.6's verdict for this review, stored or still unreadable.

commands.name: sessions clusterRetro
commands.summary: Groups one review's retro notes into themes, before the dot vote, without writing anything.

commands.name: sessions narrateDiagnostic
